title: 第1781章 双杰殿第1780章 炎阳圣地封闭
content_zh:
“可据晚辈所知，在万象圣地内修炼的修士突破到合体期后基本就不被允许一直待在万象圣地内了。
也就只有少数修士例外。”
叶非凡倒还真没想到万象圣地这个地方。
“你双十杰的身份，何尝不是一种例外。
不过你是否可以真的继续在万象圣地内修炼我也不敢保证，但总归可以去试一试。
一旦不行，圣地裁决使自会找到你说明情况。
凭你的身份，他们应该不会对你有过分的举动。”
宁平自己属于炎阳至尊名下，因此在万象至尊那边也没有任何话语权，无法为叶非凡提供助力。
“是，晚辈明白了。
后续晚辈会前往万象圣地试一下，不过如今晚辈还是打算先在宁剑府内修炼一段时间。
如果炎阳圣地能够在短时间内重新开放，晚辈就会返回炎阳圣地修炼。”
叶非凡拱了拱手，表达自己的真实想法。
“嗯，你想怎么做由你自己决定，我不过是建议而已。
宁剑府这边始终欢迎你。
至于炎阳圣地........
唉，期待它能尽快开放吧。”
宁剑府对于炎阳圣地重新开放还是比较悲观的。
发生了如此重大的事情，想要做好一些善后可不是简单的事情。
“是，晚辈这就去找个洞府修炼。”
“洞府........

嗯，你怎么说也是合体期修为了，关于洞府议事也不能太过随意。
随我来。”
宁平这才想起来宁剑府内还没有一座专属于叶非凡的洞府。
凭叶非凡现在的修为和身份足以胜任宁剑府长老一职，如果还让他和其他弟子同在一片区域就有些说不过去。
“是。”
接着宁平带着叶非凡来到宁剑府一处僻静的区域，这里就有一座大殿孤零零的坐落在此。
叶非凡目前的主要任务还是修炼，并不需要具体管理宁剑府的部分事务，因此最好选择一个不容易被人打扰的地方。
“这座双杰殿就作为你在宁剑府的洞府吧。”
宁平指着前方的大殿说道。
双杰殿？？
是双十杰的意思吗？？？
难道这座大殿就是为我而存在的？？？
这也太巧了吧！！怎么想都不可能！
叶非凡看了看大殿，并未从上面看到任何名称。
不过他对于双杰殿这个名称倒是没什么反感，要是直接反驳宁平的话那就太不给面子了。
“是，多谢宁剑主。”
就在叶非凡拱手道谢后，宁平立即伸出手指对着大殿门口的右侧柱子上不断飞舞，无形的剑气直接在柱子上划出数道剑痕。
很快双杰殿三个大字就这么出现在柱子上方，让人一看便知。
卧槽！！！
content_en:
“But as far as this junior knows, monks who practice in the Holy Land of All Things are basically not allowed to stay in the Holy Land of All Things after they break through to the integration stage.
There are only a few exceptions for monks. "
Ye Feifan really didn't expect this place, Vientiane Holy Land.
"Your status as one of the top ten heroes is nothing short of exceptional.
However, I can't guarantee whether you can really continue to practice in the Holy Land of Vientiane, but you can always give it a try.
If that doesn't work, the Holy Land Advocate will find you and explain the situation.
Based on your status, they shouldn't do anything excessive to you. "
Ning Ping himself belongs to the name of Yanyang Supreme, so he has no say in the Vientiane Supreme and cannot provide help to Ye Feifan.
"Yes, junior understands.
Later, this junior will go to the Holy Land of Vientiane to give it a try, but for now, this junior still plans to practice in Ningjian Mansion for a period of time.
If Yanyang Holy Land can be reopened in a short period of time, this junior will return to Yanyang Holy Land to practice. "
Ye Feifan cupped his hands to express his true thoughts.
“Well, it’s up to you what you want to do, I’m just suggesting.
You are always welcome here at Ning Jian Mansion.
As for Yanyang Holy Land...
Alas, let’s hope it opens soon. "
Ningjian Mansion is quite pessimistic about the reopening of Yanyang Holy Land.
Such a major event has happened, and it is not easy to do some good things in the aftermath.
"Yes, this junior will go find a cave to practice."
"Dongfu...
Well, no matter how you put it, you are still in the integration stage, so you can't be too casual about the affairs of the cave.
Come with me. "
Ning Ping then remembered that there was no cave in Ning Jian Mansion dedicated to Ye Feifan.
With Ye Feifan's current cultivation and status, he is qualified to be the elder of Ningjian Mansion. It would be unjustifiable if he is allowed to be in the same area as other disciples.
"Yes."
Then Ning Ping took Ye Feifan to a secluded area of Ningjian Mansion, where there was a lonely hall.
Ye Feifan's current main task is to practice, and he does not need to specifically manage some of the affairs of Ningjian Mansion, so it is best to choose a place where he will not be easily disturbed.
"Let this Shuangjie Palace serve as your cave in Ningjian Mansion."
Ning Ping pointed to the main hall in front and said.
Shuangjie Palace? ?
Does it mean the top ten heroes? ? ?
Does this hall exist just for me? ? ?
What a coincidence! ! It's impossible no matter how you think about it!
Ye Feifan looked at the main hall and didn't see any names on it.
However, he didn't have any objection to the name Shuangjie Palace. It would be too disrespectful to refute Ning Ping directly.
"Yes, thank you Sword Master Ning."
Just after Ye Feifan cupped his hands and thanked him, Ning Ping immediately stretched out his fingers and kept flying at the pillar on the right side of the entrance to the hall. The invisible sword energy directly made several sword marks on the pillar.
Soon the three characters "Shuangjie Palace" appeared above the pillars, making it easy for people to know at a glance.
Damn it! ! !
